value.rationale: The exact all-order 3m−2 neighborhood-complexity function gives a sharp leading coefficient and additive term for a natural hereditary graph class, strengthens an almost-linear generic exponent and measures the number of one-point adjacency types over marked parameters. A natural extremal tree-of-triangles family attains equality, making the fact useful in finite graph and model-theoretic complexity arguments.
